title: Quarters Theory ten-pair Stage-1 universe confirmation

hypotheses.market_question: Does any pair in the registered ten-pair Dukascopy FX Cash universe show a positive and stable canonical 250-pip Large Quarter Point continuation effect?
hypotheses.null: The canonical grid has no positive-and-stable incremental continuation effect versus matched 50-pip round-level controls across the pair universe.
hypotheses.alternative: At least one pair meets the preregistered positive-and-stable criterion without pair shopping.
hypotheses.mechanism: A genuinely privileged Quarters grid should reproduce beyond GBPUSD and remain stable across development and validation partitions.

method.primary_endpoint: Direction-aligned midpoint return 60 minutes after eligible crossing.
method.economic_effect_size: Canonical-minus-matched-control return in pips per pair.
method.event_definition: Candidate levels every 50 pips; canonical phase 0 modulo 250; midpoint crossing; 25-pip directional rearm.
controls: Phases 50, 100, 150 and 200 matched by year, direction, whole/half-100 roundness and four-hour UTC session.
variants: One frozen Stage-1 definition applied to all ten registered pairs.

provenance.notes: Final ten-pair closure reconstructed from exact branch commit.
